title: curvnet: latent contour representation and iterative data engine for curvature angle estimation
core_idea: Propose CurvNet, a framework that represents spine contours as parameterized latent contours enabling eigen-spine decomposition and reconstruction; it combines latent-contour-coefficient regression with anchor-box classification to improve contour detection and connectivity, and pairs this with an iterative data engine that performs image self-generation, automatic annotation, and automatic selection to expand training data and produce a clean spinal X-ray dataset without privacy leaks.
tldr: CurvNet estimates spinal curvature by learning a parameterized latent contour representation for robust contour detection and using an iterative image-generation data engine to create annotated training data for scoliosis X-ray analysis.
